name: ScholarSail
summary: An AI study workspace with flashcards, quizzes, mind maps and 3D memory palaces, plus a free tier and an 18 € Premium plan.
description: ScholarSail is an AI study tool with flashcards, quizzes, mind maps and walkable 3D memory palaces. TAAFT lists a v3.0 update in this window — this is a version bump of a product not already in the catalogue, so it is flagged as an existing product update.

pricing.details: Free (30 AI credits/month, unlimited decks and memory palaces, 250 MB storage); Premium 18 €/month (1,000 credits, 10 GB, higher-quality models and the palace editor). Launch promo LAUNCH50: 50% off for the first 3 months (9 €/month), then 18 €/month. One-off credit packs: 1 € for 50 credits (intro, one per account) and 4 € for 150 credits, lasting 12 months.
pricing.label: Freemium
